items.source: Provide access to the candidates that are defined in META-INF/spring.components component index files (see CandidateComponentsIndex(List)) or registered programmatically (see CandidateComponentsIndex()).
items.translation: 提供对定义在 `META-INF/spring.components` 组件索引文件（参见 `CandidateComponentsIndex(List)`）或通过编程方式注册的组件的访问（参见 CandidateComponentsIndex()）。

items.source: Support package for reading and managing the components index.
items.translation: 用于读取和管理组件索引的支持包。
